sink_seen_event_ids = set()
cache_reads = 0

def process_batch(batch, crash_after_pos=None):
    """batch: DataFrame whose .iterrows labels equal original df index."""
    global cache_reads
    for pos, (_, row) in enumerate(batch.iterrows()):
        if row.event_id not in sink_seen_event_ids:      # dedup on idempotency key
            sink_seen_event_ids.add(row.event_id)
        else:

        checkpoint_dir[row.partition] = row.partition_offset + 1  # commit cursor
        if crash_after_pos is not None and pos == crash_after_pos:
            raise RuntimeError(f"simulated crash at pos {pos} ({row.version})")
